title: LlmJudgeOutput
description: Output of prompt judge (SPEC 7.3). Schema version 1.1.0: every property is required so OpenAI-style strict structured output accepts the schema; quote, quote_date and reason are nullable, and null means absent. Property order is the order a guided decoder writes them: reason comes before confidence because both on-card models (vLLM 0.32 guided JSON) end their answer after confidence and, forced to add reason, padded whitespace until max_tokens.
